title: Scout craft powering up and accelerating at 8,000 to 12,000 mph

tellings.quote: One of the things I personally watched them do from a distance cuz if you get too close the fields will burn you like a microwave,

plain: Between 1965 and 1967 in the Indian Springs Valley in Nevada, small scout craft flown by tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites are said to have powered up and shot off at 8,000 to 12,000 miles an hour. Charles Hall, a man who says he served at Indian Springs and spent three years among these beings, tells Michels he watched it himself. He says he watched only from a distance, because "if you get too close the fields will burn you like a microwave".
